mandatory_resolution.salt_mg: Satisfied by declared integer salt_mg, or only when declared salt_mg is absent by deterministic integer sodium_mg × 5 / 2; otherwise not_computable.

input_contract.serving_rule: Serving size is disclosure only; it is not a numeric basis in V1.

algorithm.label: INTERNAL HEURISTIC CANDIDATE VALUES — NOT APPROVED FOR RUNTIME OR RELEASE
stages: validate standalone snapshot, perimeter, basis, units and mandatory nutrients
if non_applicable perimeter then emit non_applicable
derive salt_mg exactly from sodium_mg only when declared salt_mg is absent and the conversion state permits it
if a mandatory nutrient is missing, conflicting, non-comparable or non-convertible then emit not_computable
otherwise apply the exact integer lookup tables and serialize the bounded integer
algorithm.formula: nutrition_goodness_percent = clamp(100 - energy_points - saturated_fat_points - sugars_points - salt_points + fibre_points + protein_points, 0, 100)
algorithm.integer_units: energy_kj is an integer kJ value; all gram nutrients are integer milligrams per declared per_100g or per_100ml basis. No floating point is used.
algorithm.arithmetic: Exact integer comparisons, addition, subtraction and clipping; floating point forbidden; deterministic canonical replay.
algorithm.rounding: Not applicable; no rounding step is performed because candidate lookup outputs are already integers.
algorithm.zero_rule: Numeric zero is a valid result and is not missingness or not_computable.

conversion_policy.sodium_to_salt: Only when declared salt_mg is absent and sodium_mg is present, deterministic candidate conversion may satisfy salt_mg; otherwise not_computable.
conversion_policy.conversion_constant: salt_mg = sodium_mg × 5 / 2 = sodium_mg × 2.5; exact rational INTERNAL HEURISTIC CANDIDATE VALUE — NOT APPROVED FOR RUNTIME OR RELEASE
